about: Frame annotations for the Leeroy Jenkins replay (issue #1543).

Player positions and deaths come from Internet Historian's 'Leeroy Jenkins | Map of the Players' (2017, https://youtu.be/IAOLAw0k2DU): tracked by track-ih-map.py into ih-tracks.json, mapped to world X/Y by fit-ih-map.py (ih-map-fit.json). Per Internet Historian's map (2017), fan approximation.

The observations below were annotated by a vision model (Claude) reading frames of the guild's 480p upload: 5 fps for 86-116 s, 4 fps for 130-138 s, 1 fps elsewhere. They are now a cross-check on his map (see crossCheck).
Roster and classes are cross-checked with fan sources and labelled as such.
Every field says where it came from: observed (seen in the frames), inferred, or illustrative (filler so the replay reads; not seen).

observations.what: Raid stacked in the Hall of Binding beside a doorway; nameplates Forekin, Abduhl, Jamaal, Ritter, Madtoker, Basphemy, Therien, Ctidalwave, Juron, Spiffy.
A runner leaves the stack for the door; the raid turns after him (not Leeroy: per Internet Historian's map Leeroy is already in the Rookery).
Anfrony (POV) follows the runner through the stone doorway, Juron beside the camera.
Minimap now 'The Rookery'. Leeroy (paladin) on the checkered floor among eggs and bones; Ritter right of the camera.
First Rookery Whelp nameplates over Leeroy's position.
Leeroy buried under ~8 whelps.
Forekin and Abduhl arrive at the pile; ~10 whelp nameplates.
Ritter, Spiffy, Basphemy and Abduhl in the pile.
Anfrony (POV)'s fear: purple skulls over ~6 whelps; more eggs ahead of the camera.
Anfrony (POV) health about half (player frame turns yellow).
Whelps spread over the room; Forekin fighting at 113 s.
Anfrony (POV) is backing out over grey stone (per Internet Historian's map: towards the rubble in the south-west).
Anfrony (POV) party: slot 2 health goes red.
Slot 2 health empty, portrait grey (dead).
Chat: 'Ctidalwave has died.'
Chat: 'Therien has died.'
Slot 3 portrait grey (dead).
Slot 1 health reads 0 (dead).
Chat: 'Forekin has died.' then 'You call out for healing!'
The POV runs up a grey stone ramp; at 138-141 he fights Rage Talon Dragonspawn; back on the checkered egg floor by 144.
Slot 4 portrait grey (dead): every other member of the Anfrony (POV) party is down.
Chat: 'Abduhl has died.' (first seen at 137.0; after 135.0)
A 'Release Spirit' box: the recorder is dead.

trigger.source: real: Rookery Egg (gameobject 175124) is a trap with data2 (diameter) = 3 in cmangos/classic-db gameobject_template; the cmangos/mangos-classic core triggers traps at radius = diameter / 2 (GameObject.cpp, GAMEOBJECT_TYPE_TRAP)
trigger.marginSource: tuned, not sourced: his map places players to about 1 yd (pillar fit RMS 0.96, worst 1.30), so the bare 1.5 yd radius misses eggs a player walked over. 1.5 yd is his worst residual rounded up, and gives the closest match to the footage's whelp counts (8 on Leeroy by 1:39, about 10 by 1:40); the bare radius gives 3 by 1:39

whelps.source: which eggs hatch: any living player on the egg floor within the trigger radius (positions per Internet Historian's map); the whelp attacks the player who set it off, then the nearest living player. Swings and damage are illustrative.

fear.source: observed (the effect); the spell is inferred from the recorder being a warrior

rosterSource: fan source: old wowwiki LEEROY page roster (13 names); nameplates checked against the 90-93 s frames (Forekin, Abduhl, Jamaal, Ritter, Madtoker, Basphemy, Therien, Ctidalwave, Chrisym, Juron, Spiffy legible). The UBRS cap was 10-15, so not every listed name need be in the room.

ihSync.source: sync-ih-inset.py: the inset of the footage on his map matched against the original upload, 72 one-second matches; original second = map second + 78.5

partyFrameDeathsSource: observed on the recorder's party frames: four party members dead by 135.4 s; names not legible at 480p

crossCheck.ihMap: walks in through the door at 1:26.5 and is alone in the room until 1:34.5
crossCheck.frames: the v1 annotation had Leeroy leaving the hall at 1:33; that runner's nameplate is not legible, and the raid's own arrival (POV through the door at 1:34.8) matches his map (Anfrony's dot enters at 1:34.1)
crossCheck.verdict: his map; the 1:33 runner was another raid member

crossCheck.ihMap: the west door, from the Hall of Binding at floor level (minimap 'Hall of Binding' before, 'The Rookery' after)
crossCheck.frames: agrees; v1 had used the east stairs and a drop off the terrace, taken from modern Rookery pulls in Chronicle logs

crossCheck.ihMap: Anfrony leaves the pile south-west at ~2:06 and reaches the far south-west corner (rubble) by ~2:14
crossCheck.frames: the v1 note said 'backing out over grey stone towards the east'; the grey stone fits the rubble in the south-west

crossCheck.ihMap: three dots go dithered: Basphemy 2:10.5, Ctidalwave 2:11.7, Chrisym 2:18.3; everyone else is still drawn alive when his map ends (2:49.7)
crossCheck.frames: the recorder's party frames show four party members dead at 2:12.0, 2:14.4, 2:15.0 and 2:15.4
crossCheck.verdict: the fixture still uses his named deaths (Basphemy, Ctidalwave, Chrisym); the chat agrees on Ctidalwave and names three more he draws alive. Using the chat deaths is a follow-up.
crossCheck.chat: the recorder's chat names his party's deaths: Ctidalwave 2:12.0, Therien 2:14, Forekin 2:15, Abduhl by 2:17 (matching the party frames' 2:12.0, 2:14.4, 2:15.0, 2:15.4), and a Release Spirit box shows the recorder dead by 2:36

crossCheck.ihMap: Anfrony is in the pile at 1:44
crossCheck.frames: his fear (purple skulls over the whelps) at 1:44
